title: Each relay queue action in its own module
what: Split the handler of lib/relay_cmd/queue/__init__.py into one module per action: the 15 words count, show, history, check, migrate, land, ip, take, release, done, drop, add, note, edit, start (tests/relay_commands.py QUEUE_FLOOR lists them), plus the view fallback (`relay queue <view>` / `--view <view>`, the table default) which stays as `fallback(args)` in __init__.py. Each action module has `USAGE` (its lines of the queue usage, first line `relay queue <word> ...`), `WRITES` (True for add, land, ip, release, drop, take, start, done, note, edit, migrate as in QUEUE_WRITES today; False for count, show, history, check) and `run(args)`; the package's `run` dispatches by word through the same `find` rule as the top level, and `relay queue` bare keeps its current output and exit code.
- `relay_cli.find` replaces the discovery code in lib/queue_ext (its own module-finding for views); the views in lib/queue_ext/ keep working and `relay queue <view>` still lists and runs them.

- Guard: from move 5 an action module answers before the guard's table, so each `WRITES` must equal today's table verdict (the agreement test of move 5 enforces it, in the move that writes it). Do not edit the guard.

- Tests: tests/test_cmd_queue_<action>.py per action (move 3 as built: tests/test_cmd_files.py requires one file per action module, naming it when missing; and the package's own tests/test_cmd_queue.py from move 7 stays). Each holds the help literal and one smoke case; most actions need a temporary git repository (run_relay(git=True)) and a fixture item written through `relay queue add` into the temp repo, never the live .relay/queue.
Done: full gate green; every queue word behaves as before; no action is left in __init__.py except the dispatch and the view fallback.

Module interface (every moved command): `USAGE: str` whose first line is `relay <cmd> ...`; `WRITES: bool`; optional `READ_FLAGS` (sync's `--dry`); `def run(args: list[str]) -> int`. Names match [a-z][a-z0-9_]*, a typed `-` maps to `_`. A package's `__init__.py` has the header `USAGE`, `WRITES` for its bare use, and an optional `fallback(args)`; mixed commands (queue, check, improve, bench, license) become packages with one module per action.

Test convention (tests/cmd_harness.py docstring, move 3): each command's own test file tests/test_cmd_<cmd>.py (tests/test_cmd_<cmd>_<action>.py for an action of a package) holds two cases: (1) `relay <cmd> --help` prints the usage lines it printed before the move, copied as a literal; (2) one smoke case with harmless arguments asserting the exit code and one output line, run through `run_relay` from tests/cmd_harness.py (it returns code, stdout, stderr and the files written, in temporary HOME, RELAY_HOME, RELAY_ROOT and cwd). For a command that cannot run in a temporary tree, the case is its usage refusal. tests/test_cmd_files.py fails, naming the file, for any module under lib/relay_cmd/ without its test file. tests/test_cmd_smoke.py already holds one table SMOKE with a case per command (all 21); keep the moved command's case there working, and note that under the empty RELAY_ROOT calibrate, install, flows, rules and doctor fail on a missing file before they read their arguments, so for those the command's own file must replace the case with one whose outcome depends on an argument. This catches an off-by-one in how the dispatcher hands args to run() (with or without the command name), which the help tests (they stop before run) and ruff do not see.

Replacing queue items' `where`: the open items that name lib/relay_cmd/queue/__init__.py or the shared handler get the action file instead. Record how many items the start filter holds before and after.

Traps for this move: keep imports lint-clean (ruff F; a dropped import of a helper is ruff F821); tests that import from the repo root must still run under the short gate; done items name their `test` ids, which are found by name, so do not rename tests; RULE_TESTS names in lib/relay_textonly.py must stay valid; tests never touch the live .relay/queue (use a temporary folder); a move that takes a function another running lane changed ports that lane's hunk by hand (start rule below); the size marker leaves a file in the move that brings it under 600 lines.
why: Move 8 of the split of relay into one module per subcommand. The owner decided it on 28 Oct: "каждая подкоманда может и должна жить в своем модуле, этот подход должен быть распространен на весь relay". Waits for move 7 (queue as a package). Two open items (ip 85 each) name their action module instead of bin/relay or the shared handler.
